<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.3in 0 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.3in 0 0">September 21, 2010</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 2.7in 0 0"><B><U>RE: Viral Genetics Latin America, LLC (the &quot;VGLA&quot;)
</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 2.7in 0 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 2.7in 0 0">Dear Sir:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Further to our discussions, and for good and
lawful consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, Viral Genetics, Inc., a Delaware corporation
(the &quot;Company&quot;) and you agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 6pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 15pt; text-align: right">1.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">You represent and warrant that you are the owner of a membership interest of 1% of
VGLA (the &quot;LLC Interest&quot;), and further that the LLC Interest is free of all encumbrances, liens, or claims and that
you are free to sell, transfer, dispose and assign same.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 6pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 15pt; text-align: right">2.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Upon execution hereof, the Company hereby agrees to purchase, and you agree to sell,
transfer and assign to the Company, the LLC Interest in exchange for two million five hundred thousand (2,500,000) shares of common
stock of the Company (the &quot;Shares&quot;).</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 6pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 15pt; text-align: right">3.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">You have requested and hereby instruct the Company to deliver the Shares as follows:</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 35pt; text-align: right">a.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">1,050,000 Shares shall be registered to:</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 40pt">David W. Odell</P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 40pt">2927 De la Vina Street</P>
